mechanism.summary: Route only already-eligible ordinary direct-leaf bytecode calls through the existing opcode executor on an explicit frame scheduler whose operand values live in one VM-owned contiguous stack; suspended frames retain relative stack bases and a move-cheap hot header rather than an independent operand Vec and recursively constructed Vm.
mechanism.generality: Admission remains the existing is_direct_leaf_function predicate, after the existing numeric and this-property leaf probes. The mechanism depends only on function metadata and bytecode semantics. It never inspects source text, paths, benchmark identity, function names, iteration counts, argument values, checksums, or expected results. Native, Proxy, bound, constructor, generator, async, direct-eval, with-aware, closure-producing, and guard-false calls remain on the existing recursive fallback.
semantic_risks: keeping every operand and TryFrame stack depth relative to the active frame while parent operands remain below the child base
preserving zero through three argument order, receiver binding, direct readonly upvalue cells, realm/module/agent context, and function rebinding fallbacks
running child finally and disposal handling before restoring a parent and offering one thrown value through every restored catch/finally boundary without changing identity
clearing completed child values and frame-owned references before bounded storage reuse so no object or cell lifetime leaks across calls
avoiding a dispatch-loop indirection or branch regression for root frames, native/numeric fast hits, and non-eligible calls

profile_evidence.shared_cost: Of 2,254 runtime main-thread samples, exclusive top-of-stack costs include 385 in call_direct_leaf_function, 220 in Vm frame construction, 110 dropping FrameState, 68 dropping CallEnv, 34 installing the marked call realm, and 27 recycling the per-frame operand stack. These 844 samples, or 37.4 percent, are frame/call setup and teardown before counting allocator traffic, while another 1,228 samples remain in the ordinary opcode and boxed-Value path that the same continuous stack preserves rather than duplicating.
